pool.text: A single-story Gothic structure was built in the Wuchang district.
An English newspaper named Hankow Times was founded in the city.
The first Chinese newspaper to appear in Hankou, Chao-wen Hsin-pao, was founded.
According to some sources, the tower was burned last.
The Hanyang Arsenal was founded with funds diverted from the Nanyang Fleet.
Wuhan University was established.
The resulting city was proclaimed as the traditional Chinese characters for Wuhan.
The Wuhan Nationalist Government was established in Wuhan and ended later that year.
The Wuhan coup was a political shift made by Wang Jingwei towards Chiang Kai-shek.
A train ferry was established to transport train cars from Hankou.
The city was the site of the Battle of Wuhan during the war.
Wuhan was bombed by American bombers with the approval of Chiang Kai-Shek.
People's Liberation Army troops entered Wuhan on the afternoon of Monday.
The Changjiang Water Resources Commission was reestablished with its headquarters in Wuhan.
Huazhong Institute of Technology was founded.
The whole project for the bridge was completed and an opening ceremony was held.
The first bridge was built over the Yangtze.
The Wuhan Branch of Chinese Academy of Sciences was founded.
Hundreds of factories were built, including Wuhan Iron and Steel which opened.
SARS-CoV-2 was first discovered in Wuhan and caused the COVID-19 pandemic.
